shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "rg -n -m 80 \"modal|dialog|Dialog\" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- files ---\\n'; rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md; printf '\\n--- exports ---\\n'; rg -n \"(Dialog|Modal|Button)\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/typings/index.d.ts | head -80; printf '\\n--- dialog types ---\\n'; rg -n \"interface Dialog|type Dialog|DialogProps|onConfirm|onCancel|open\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/typings/components/Dialog/Dialog.d.ts -n -C 3; printf '\\n--- button types ---\\n'; rg -n \"interface Button|type Button|ButtonProps|view|size|width|onClick\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/typings/components/Button/Button.d.ts -n -C 2 | head -140"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"export.*Dialog|export.*Button\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Dialog -maxdepth 2 -type f -name '*.d.ts' -print; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button -maxdepth 2 -type f -name '*.d.ts' -print; printf '\\n--- app/main ---\\n'; cat src/main.tsx src/App.tsx; printf '\\n--- config ---\\n'; cat vite.config.ts tsconfig.json index.html"

/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "BUTTON_VIEWS" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/constants.d.ts; rg -n "interface DialogFooterProps|type DialogFooterProps|children|onClick" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Dialog/DialogFooter/DialogFooter.d.ts -C 4; rg -n "interface DialogHeaderProps|type DialogHeaderProps|title" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Dialog/DialogHeader/DialogHeader.d.ts -C 4'
